cycles.method: MKII OS 1.40C, RAM base 06e08f35c62c02ce, package 0c5632f6. The longest guarded render in the six-voice 24-bit T1/T5 sequencer and MIDI windows was 17,845 ticks at 132 MHz in the T1 Part-switch trace. Times include stock Flex and interruptions. The static calculation bounds Grain-owned instructions. Its zero-wait-state model excludes SDRAM stalls and interrupts, so a full elapsed-cycle upper bound remains unmeasured.

load.method: Same 12-second USB MIDI trace on the 100 BPM card-free Part, stereo R3 on T1 and T5. Empty-inventory Flex peaked at 70.3% of a frame. One six-voice Grain on T1 or T5 peaked at 89.6% or 93.0% respectively. All three windows showed a median 100% CPU meter and zero new skipped renders. Opening 20-channel USB audio separately produced skips on both Grain tracks. See evidence/timing/recorder.json.

stress.droppedExplanation: One trace submitted 13,249 USB MIDI events in 12 seconds. Receive errors, transmit drops and render skips held steady in the MIDI-only windows, including a completed Part 2/1 change. End-to-end message delivery and stuck notes were not counted. The 20-channel audio capture had render drops, counted separately in evidence/timing/recorder.json.
